info.title: FleetBooks API
info.description:
REST API for FleetBooks (tourist transport fleet & finance).

1. POST /api/auth/login/ with your username and password.
2. Click **Authorize** and paste the `access` token.
Drivers can use /api/driver/ only; office users /api/office/ and the module endpoints, by role.
